subject.why: Depicts the requested pastel pink house with fence, lawn, and porthole window.

category.why: Features a simple base ground plane against a clear blue sky with horizon clouds.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The picket fence extends to both lateral edges, lacking clear side margins.

colour.why: Bright, saturated palette with clear contrast against the blue background.

detail.why: Clean stylized surfaces without noisy textures or excessive micro-details.

style.why: Chunky 3D volumes and smooth satin finish match the reference style.

fix: Scale down the composition slightly so the fence does not touch or get cut off by the side edges.
